leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a Node.js project with Express for REST service development
Implement route handlers for CRUD operations on a sample resource
Configure middleware to parse JSON request bodies
Integrate Swagger UI to visualize API documentation
Construct OpenAPI specification for API endpoints
Apply validation schemas to request parameters and bodies
Bind route definitions to corresponding controller functions
Render API documentation through automated OpenAPI generation
